# Exploration > Hazards

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md)*

The Hazard rules and every hazard tagged [Hazard].

## Entries

- [Burning [Hazard]](Burning.md): A burning creature or object takes 1d4 Fire damage at the start of each of its turns.
- [Dehydration [Hazard]](Dehydration.md): A creature requires an amount of water per day based on its size, as shown in the Water Needs per Day table.
- [Falling [Hazard]](Falling.md): A creature that falls takes 1d6 Bludgeoning damage at the end of the fall for every 10 feet it fell, to a maximum of 20d6.
- [Hazard](Hazard.md): A hazard is an environmental danger.
- [Malnutrition [Hazard]](Malnutrition.md): A creature needs an amount of food per day based on its size, as shown in the Food Needs per Day table.
- [Suffocation [Hazard]](Suffocation.md): A creature can hold its breath for a number of minutes equal to 1 plus its Constitution modifier (minimum of 30 seconds) before suffocation begins.
